messages.subject: Venture Pulse Weekly: cleantech funding rebounds in Q4
messages.plaintextBody: This week: UK cleantech and mobility startups raised £640m in Q4, up 22% on the prior quarter, led by battery and fleet-electrification deals. Plus: the new EIS sunset clause explained, and five GCs to watch. Read online. Unsubscribe at any time.
